metadata.title: Change permission requirement for adding team members
metadata.author: KKNithin

description:
this is in relation to bug #1644

# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary
to add-member to a team we need teams.update permission instead of teams.write permission

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
Failure when adding a team member which complains about teams.write permission

## 🐞 Root Cause
/teams/{team-id}/add-member api needs teams.write instead of teams.update

## 💡 Fix Description
modified the permission to teams.update

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body: Thank you. Rebased and did some testing.

commits.message:
fix: use teams.manage_members permission for team member operations

Change permission requirement for adding, updating, and removing team
members from the non-existent teams.write to teams.manage_members.

The teams.write permission was never defined in the permission system,
causing team owners to be denied access to member management operations.
Using teams.manage_members aligns with the API router (routers/teams.py)
and is properly granted to team owners via fallback permissions.

Closes #1644

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
